documents.refund.md:
# Refunds
Customers can return unused products within 30 days. Refunds are sent to the original payment method within five business days.
documents.remote.md:
# Çalışma düzeni
Ekip salı ve perşembe günleri evden çalışabilir. Pazartesi, çarşamba ve cuma ofise gelinir.
documents.checkout.md:
# Ödeme hatası
Sepetten ödeme adımına geçerken adres alanının boş kalması işlemi durduruyor. Çözüm, teslimat adresini zorunlu yapmak.
documents.release.md:
# Release decision
The Orion release is scheduled for 22 October 2026. Mina owns the release checklist. The pilot was postponed because mobile login failed.
documents.warehouse.md:
# Warehouse model
The orders table has one row per order, keyed by order_id. Session counts belong in the sessions table, with one row per session.
documents.invoice.md:
# Fatura süreci
Tedarikçi faturaları her ayın son iş gününde finans ekibine gönderilir. Ödeme onayını Deniz verir.
documents.retention.md:
# Log retention
Application logs are deleted after 14 days. Backups are retained for 90 days. Raw payment card data must never enter application logs.
documents.coffee.md:
# Ofis mutfağı
Kahve çekirdeği siparişini Ece verir. Filtre kahve makinesi her cuma temizlenir.
documents.cache.md:
# Cache policy
Inventory availability is cached for 45 seconds. Product descriptions are cached for six hours. A price update invalidates the product price cache immediately.
documents.incident.md:
# Incident escalation
For a failed warehouse ingestion job, contact the on-call data engineer in the data-ops channel. Rerun only the failed partition; do not reload all history.
documents.leave.md:
# İzin başvurusu
Yıllık izin talebi başlangıç tarihinden en az yedi iş günü önce ekip liderine iletilir. Hastalık izninde bu süre şartı aranmaz.
documents.credentials.md:
# Service access
Production service credentials rotate every 60 days. Staging credentials rotate every 120 days. Credentials are stored in the approved secret manager.
documents.shipping.md:
# Teslimat politikası
Standart kargo siparişleri iki iş gününde depodan çıkar. Ekspres siparişler aynı gün 14:00 öncesinde verilirse o gün kargolanır.
documents.schema.md:
# Event contract
The purchase event requires transaction_id and currency. Event timestamps use UTC. Test events must set environment to staging.
documents.approval.md:
# Approval limits
Infrastructure purchases above 5000 euros require both finance and engineering approval. Purchases at or below 5000 euros require the team lead only.
documents.decoy.md:
# Orion experiment
The Orion mobile experiment started on 8 September 2026. This experiment is separate from the Orion release milestone.
